message:
Now I see the issue. In `elf_find_dynptr`, the loop iterates `dynp < last` where `last = sz_dynseg + (char *)dynseg`. The `get_te64(&dynp->d_tag)` reads 8 bytes. If `dynseg` points near the end of a MemBuffer and `sz_dynseg` is such that the last `Elf64_Dyn` entry is only partially within the buffer, then `get_te64` will read past the end.

Let me look at how `dynseg` and `sz_dynseg` are set. Let me look at the `elf_find_ptype` function and where `dynseg` is assigned.

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>sed -n '2241,2280p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/p_lx_elf.cpp && echo "=====" && grep -n "dynseg\s*=\|sz_dynseg\s*=" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/p_lx_elf.cpp | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜ode>
